notes.title: Announcing Ver.2.0.0
notes.notes:
Ver.2.0.0 releases September 25th, 2024.

[h1]Ver.2.0.0 Patch Notes[/h1]
Please check the list of changes below for details on the main improvements and fixes in this patch.

[h2]○ Screen Settings Expanded[/h2]

“Resolution” has been added to the Screen settings in the Options menu.
Under “Resolution”, you can choose from two different presets or create your own custom setting.

These settings cannot be changed after starting the game.
Some setups may experience some instability if these settings are changed.
Consider reverting back to the default settings if you experience any instability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/e82b02aded94da0e0871043052013dc3d96d604e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]"Original Mode" Preset[/b][/h3]
Display at the game’s original resolution.
Upon selecting "Original Mode", the following settings will be applied.

[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [td]Internal Resolution[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]Original[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Internal Upscaling[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]Default[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Movie[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]Original[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h3][b]"Adjusted Mode" Preset[/b][/h3]
Displays the game at your current monitor’s highest possible resolution. Has sharper visuals compared to Original Mode.
Upon selecting "Adjusted Mode", the following settings will be applied.

[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [td]Internal Resolution[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]FHD (1080p)[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Internal Upscaling[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]Internal Upscaling: Highest resolution possible from FHD (1080p), WQHD (1440p), or 4K (2160p). [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Movie[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]High Resolution[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]Should your specs fall below FHD, Internal Resolution will be set to Original and Internal Upscaling will be set to Default.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/84e93b13edc97d3aa7636f0c2761e750941ea97d.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=se3MTQY1hF0;full][previewyoutube=QBFNUVBVa3o;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]"Custom" Preset[/b][/h3]
"Internal Resolution", "Internal Upscaling", and "Movie" can be adjusted to suit your current specs.

[b]1. Internal Resolution[/b]
Under "Internal Resolution", you can now choose to have the game render in FHD or at its original resolution.

[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [td]Original[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]Renders the game at its original resolution.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]FHD*1[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]Increases the game's internal resolution to FHD when rendering.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]*1 May not be selectable depending on your setup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/ef48f12169cbbce4e6d74aebd85f1d32b5815bb4.jpg[/img]
[b]2. Internal Upscaling[/b]
Under "Internal Upscaling", you can choose to apply additional upscaling methods to scale the game up to your setup's highest possible resolution.
Changing this setting will result in sharper visuals.
Note that depending on your setup, this may not be selectable.

[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [td]Default[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]Displays the game at the same resolution as the original Master Collection release.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]FHD*1[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]Displays the game in FHD using an upscaling method different to the original Master Collection release. *2 *3[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]WQHD*1[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]Displays the game in WQHD using an upscaling method different to the original Master Collection release. *2 *3[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]4K*1[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]Displays the game in 4K using an upscaling method different to the original Master Collection release. *2[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]*1 May not be selectable depending on your setup.
*2 Results in sharp visuals.
*3 If your monitor can support a resolution that is higher than the resolution selected, then the game will be displayed using the original Master Collection release's upscaling method at the highest possible resolution available.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/0737527eae5b50091d00c77b9e1c38b6095067c0.jpg[/img]
[b]3. Movie[/b]
You can choose to set in-game movies to their original or higher resolution versions. 
When selected, some movies will be displayed at a higher resolution.

Movie: Original
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/56e9bb191a5216809716cf5caf345e98b1ae5fc8.jpg[/img]
Movie: High Resolution
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/2b47214032602bcb4e7de8ecf282314db7b3798c.jpg[/img]

[h2]○ Additional Control Settings[/h2]
"CONTROL SETTINGS" has been added under ADDITIONAL SETTINGS.
The following settings can be changed under CONTROL SETTINGS:

[h3]1. CONTROLLER SETTINGS[/h3]
You can assign controls for your controller under "CONTROLLER SETTINGS".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/8cea27c4cef27cd6f6074ccc86e1a4a6f8dfc16b.jpg[/img]

[h3]2. KEYBOARD ＆ MOUSE SETTINGS[/h3]
You can select one of three Layout Types under "KEYBOARD ＆ MOUSE SETTINGS", and if you choose Custom you will be able to assign your own controls. 

[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [td]LAYOUT A[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]The control layout used up to Ver.1.5.1.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]LAYOUT B[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]The new control layout that can be selected after Ver.2.0.0.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]CUSTOM[/td]
        [td]：[/td]
        [td]A control layout that can be freely customized.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]*If there are overlapping controls, some actions may not function properly.
*In the event some actions do not function properly, please attempt reassigning them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/e2125428670915fb066a8a68c4fc1bef3e16f4e8.jpg[/img]

[h3]3. ZOOM IN/OUT SENSITIVITY[/h3]
"ZOOM IN/OUT SENSITIVITY" has been added under MOUSE SENSITIVITY.
You can adjust the scroll wheel sensitivity when zooming in/out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/8a785a09cb6385a680f97d419d2ddf8e147ab95d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Ver. 1.2.2 Beta Update Notice
notes.notes:
We have released a beta update that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2131650/view/3736358345122233746]resolves the abnormal speed issue[/url]. However, as this is a beta update there is a possibility that it may cause other issues to occur, and as such, we ask for your understanding. If this happens, please opt out of the beta and revert to the original release version.
Follow the steps below to opt into the beta.
[olist]
[*] Go to your Library from within the Steam Client and select “METAL GEAR SOLID 3: Snake Eater - Master Collection Version”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/28260642afeb243ee142101e2d61905fef736b89.png[/img]
[*] Right click and select “Properties”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/234b4c6c2a7f0cd86fee3cfcb3e4e47d9d7245b0.png[/img]
[*]  Select “Betas” and input "[b]WKAPhRCJYALyGkLmHZ[/b]" into the bar under "Private Betas" section.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/11a0ad4fa3a1ffe2e47477d63da3287eff642c5e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/39bedb5b48242c235339598318529f5a19c9a863.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/4972a2ab9cc1dbbb7f601c4bc17bc148c20b31e0.png[/img]
If successful, "Opt into: beta - beta test" will be displayed in blue underneath the bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/29b582499e3ec990834b142cb0854d61bb5969fd.png[/img]
The option to select "beta" from the dropdown menu in "Beta Participation" will then become available.
Once selected, the beta update will download.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/5df604909f580873d637131e240e5bbd255920c7.png[/img]
You will be able to play the beta version once the download is complete.
To revert to the original release version, simply change “beta” back to “None” in the dropdown menu. Once the download reverting the beta update is complete, you will be able to play the original release version.
[*] For those who are tried and are using the temporary solution, make sure to reset the settings to the original settings first before launching the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: How to install the DLCs
notes.notes:
[h1]How to install the DLCs[/h1]

[h2]Disclaimers[/h2]
[list]
[*] Currently, there is a known issue where users are unable to install the DLC when selecting the "Download" button from within the game.
This "Download" button will be removed in a future update.
[*] Make sure that you close the game app before installing/uninstalling the DLC.
Make sure to also wait until the install/uninstall is complete before launching the game app.
[*] The list of DLCs that are available will vary depending on which regional version of the game you own. The screenshot displayed in these instructions are based on the European regional version. The details can be found in the DLC section of your Steam Client.
[/list]

[olist]
[*] Go to your Library from within the Steam Client and select "METAL GEAR SOLID 3: Snake Eater - Master Collection Version"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/28260642afeb243ee142101e2d61905fef736b89.png[/img]
[*] Right click and select "Properties"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/234b4c6c2a7f0cd86fee3cfcb3e4e47d9d7245b0.png[/img]
[*] Go to the DLC section, select the DLC that you would like to install, and deselect the ones you don't want to install.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/27180650d78f868d06f8bb958c729f009c19402f.png[/img]
This setting can be changed at any point in time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277712/3ac2588d90bde82bdd1eaa43b24fcb6411bc208e.png[/img]
[/olist]

notes.title: Workaround for when the game is running at high speeds
notes.notes:
We are aware that users are reporting issues with the Steam® version of METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1 resulting in the game running at abnormal speeds.
We ask for your patience while we conduct a thorough investigation.

We recommend that you try the following workaround as a temporary solution.

[h3]For those using a graphics card made by NVIDIA® [/h3]
